questions.question: What did Naomi advise Ruth to do at the threshing floor?
options: Uncover Boaz's feet and lie down, seeking his protection
Gather up the extra grain quietly while all the workers slept
Slip away from the floor before anyone else awoke
Confront Boaz openly and demand that he marry her
questions.answer: Uncover Boaz's feet and lie down, seeking his protection

questions.question: What did Ruth ask Boaz to do?
options: To take her in as a household servant
To let her keep gleaning in his field
To repay the debts owed by Naomi
To marry her by acting as kinsman-redeemer
questions.answer: To marry her by acting as kinsman-redeemer

questions.question: Boaz blessed Ruth and promised to act as redeemer if a nearer relative would not.
